title: plugin.json `hooks` field
description: Hook configuration declared in .claude-plugin/plugin.json, in addition to hooks/hooks.json: a relative path to a .json hooks file (same format as hooks/hooks.json, starting with `./`), an inline object of event -> matcher groups (NOT wrapped in a `hooks` key), or an array mixing both.

pluginManifestHooksItem.title: plugin.json hooks entry
pluginManifestHooksItem.description: Either a `./`-relative path to a .json hooks file or an inline event -> matcher groups object.

anyOf.description: Relative path (starting with `./`, ending in `.json`) to a hooks file in hooks/hooks.json format. A path containing `..` fails `claude plugin validate`.
